title: Native derived tensor restricted to bounded constructible Weil complexes
statement: Fix a finite field $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$, use the native ambient category $D(\mathcal W_X)$ and its full bounded constructible subcategory $\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)$ of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], and the native derived tensor bifunctor $\otimes^L_{B_X}$ of [def-sf-derived-weil-category-and-operations]. Its bounded constructible closure is [lem-sf-derived-weil-tensor-hom-adjunction]. Define the restricted bifunctor $\otimes^L_{X_0}:\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)\times\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)\to\mathrm{WC}^{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)$ to send $(K,L)$ to the same ambient object $K\otimes^L_{B_X}L$, with the bounded constructible membership proof supplied by that closure statement. On a pair of morphisms $(f:K\to K',g:L\to L')$ its map is the same ambient tensor morphism $f\otimes^L_{B_X}g$, regarded as a morphism in the full subcategory.
